description: Demolition of building N and erection of a new two storey building (N1+N2) for B1 offices, extension and refurbishment of building M and L with a link between two buildings for B1 offices. Change of use of building O to create two x 2 bedroom houses.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The buildings labelled on drawing no. 2511/1B and 2511/2A as N1 and N2, M1 and M2 and L1 and L2 shall be used for B1 use and for no other purpose including any other purpose in Class B1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings labelled on drawing no. 2511/1B and 2511/2A as N1 and N2, M1 and M2 and L1 and L2 hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - All existing windows and doors to buildings L2, M and O shall be retained in situ and replacements shall be approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and on site before any work on the site is commenced.

Condition : 8 - A schedule of all repairs and works to existing buildings including the chimney base shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of works.

Condition : 9 - Full details of all ground surface treatment on the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to commencement of works on the site.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.
Condition : 10 - Details of the entrance to the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of development.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the buildings are occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 12 - The Class B1 use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times 8am to 6.00pm on Mondays to Fridays and 8.00am to 1.00pm on Saturdays, and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 13 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7.00am to midday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 14 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 15 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the buildings shown on drawing no.s 2511/1B and 2511/2A shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 17 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing 2511/1B and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 18 - There shall be no more than five car parking spaces on the site.

Condition : 19 - Before development commences details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and implemented.

Condition : 20 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 21 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority.

Condition : 22 - The change of use of Building O to create two x 2 bedroom houses shall not be carried out prior to the demolition of Building N and erection of a new two storey building (N1+N2) for B1 offices, extension and refurbishment of Building M and L with a link between two buildings for B1 offices.
